name: h3-t2v
description: Build a MiniMax H3 text-to-video (T2VA) prompt from a textual creative request. Use when no supplied image acts as a required first or final frame. Do NOT use when an image must be the literal opening frame (h3-i2v), an endpoint pair (h3-first-last), the final frame (h3-last-frame), or a full-reference rewrite (h3-reference).
